title: Bitcoin holds near $77,600 as traders position into the September FOMC decision
summary: Bitcoin traded around $77,593 on Tuesday, down 0.01% on the day, with 24-hour volume of $20.6bn on major spot exchanges and dominance at 58.15% as broader crypto slipped 2.31%. CoinStats' AI feed reported a one-day gain of 1.78% to roughly $78,187 with an intraday high near $79,451, leaving BTC still down 1.29% over seven days. Polymarket's 'Bitcoin price on September 15?' market has generated $70,700 in volume since launch on September 8. Traders are positioning into Wednesday's FOMC decision, where FedWatch now prices a 92.4% probability of a 25bp hike.
